categories.main_business_segments: Encompass Health operates a single primary business segment following the July 2022 spin-off of its home health and hospice business: inpatient rehabilitation hospitals. As of December 31, 2022, the company owned or operated 153 inpatient rehabilitation hospitals across the United States and Puerto Rico, making it the largest owner and operator of such facilities in the nation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company delivers specialized, interdisciplinary rehabilitative care using teams of nurses, physical, occupational, and speech therapists, guided by physician orders and case managers. Encompass Health leverages advanced clinical protocols, electronic medical records, data analytics, and technology-enabled care coordination tools to drive high-quality outcomes and operational efficiency. The company also utilizes pre-fabrication construction technology for new hospital development and has implemented onsite hemodialysis systems in select hospitals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Encompass Health primarily serves patients requiring intensive inpatient rehabilitation following acute medical events such as strokes, hip fractures, neurological conditions, and other significant physical or cognitive disabilities. The majority of patients are aged 65 and older, with 91% admitted via referrals from acute-care hospitals. Key customer groups include Medicare and Medicare Advantage beneficiaries, managed care and commercial insurance patients, and Medicaid recipients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in 36 states and Puerto Rico, with a concentration in the eastern United States and Texas. Its network of 153 hospitals provides broad national coverage, with ongoing expansion into new and existing markets through de novo hospital openings and joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: Encompass Health operates at the downstream, patient-facing end of the healthcare supply chain, providing direct post-acute inpatient rehabilitation services. The company receives referrals from upstream acute-care hospitals and coordinates with downstream home health agencies and other post-acute providers for patient transitions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the hospital network, adding bed capacity, strengthening relationships with healthcare systems and payors, and delivering superior patient outcomes in a cost-effective manner. The company invests in technology-enabled care coordination, data analytics, and innovation in post-acute care delivery. R&D efforts focus on clinical best practices, advanced therapies, and leveraging large post-acute datasets to support value-based care and improved outcomes.
categories.revenue_model: Encompass Health generates revenue primarily through patient care services reimbursed by Medicare (65.3% of 2022 revenue), Medicare Advantage (15.1%), managed care/commercial insurance (11.6%), Medicaid (4.2%), and other sources. The majority of revenue is derived from fixed payment amounts per discharge under the Medicare IRF-PPS system, with additional revenue from outpatient services and management fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The inpatient rehabilitation industry is highly fragmented, with Encompass Health holding a leading position in terms of patients treated, revenues, and number of hospitals. Competitors include rehabilitation units within acute-care hospitals, other freestanding rehabilitation providers (including a public company with 31 hospitals), and skilled nursing facilities offering some rehabilitation services. The company differentiates itself through scale, clinical outcomes, cost-effectiveness, and technology adoption.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Encompass Health reported net operating revenues of $4.35 billion, up 8.3% from 2021, with 211,116 patient discharges and 10,356 licensed beds. The company has demonstrated consistent growth through new hospital openings, bed additions, and joint ventures, with a strong balance sheet, significant owned real estate, and ample liquidity. The company targets 6-10 new hospitals and 80-120 new beds annually.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Encompass Health emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective, integrated patient care, superior clinical outcomes, and extensive use of technology and data analytics. Its scale, standardized best practices, and strategic partnerships with acute-care hospitals enable it to deliver consistent, measurable results and adapt to regulatory and market changes. The company’s focus on patient outcomes, care coordination, and innovation positions it as a preferred partner for payors, referral sources, and patients.
